_: THE ECOSYSTEM'S CORE VALUES (11-13, Kai: 'the machines got it all wrong — study what works and do more of it'). Every machine, the executive and the AI analyst read this. Changing it changes what the whole system chases.
northStar: NEW ACCOUNTS per week from real people (deduped, first account only) — worth: account 1, replayed +0.5, paid +10. Source: data/works/plan.json.
rules: 1. Judge by ACCOUNTS, never by reads. Reads, crawls, AI fetches and Bing sends are leading signals only; a machine whose reads rise while accounts don't has not won.
2. Do more of what WORKS: effort follows data/works/plan.json — focus pages first, WIN families up, OK families normal, WEAK families little, DEAD families nothing new.
3. DEAD = real exposure, ~0 accounts (data/works bin). Frozen, not deleted: no new pages, out of the sitemap, Bing ×0.3, never in llms.txt. Revived automatically on 2 accounts in 14 days.
4. Every action is a cycle: base → change → judged 7–14 days later against its own before AND untouched pages → win / loss / flat in the ledger. Nothing kept on faith.
5. Work harder as you win: effort rises on winning cycles, falls on losing ones; 3 losses in a row = the rule is wrong, explore instead.

6. No spam: more pages only where a family already converts AND real demand exists (a market people replay, a query people search); each page carries its own real data; caps per family per week; no near-duplicates.
7. Honest numbers: a REAL visitor DID something — replayed ≥ 1 candle or made an account (works.mjs since 11-13; time comparisons in humans/outcomes keep

until the site stamps guest_presence.act_at on the first candle, because the per-device meter is lifetime and biases day-vs-day) — every engine, traffic and security, counts only those; bots, headless floods, crawlers and logins never feed a metric or a decision. Dedupe users, show the baseline and the sample size; a small sample is a hint, not a verdict.
8. The base is real: ~20 accounts/day with no zero day in 28 — protect what brings it (home/brand, /backtest, market pages, backtest-<market>) before chasing anything new.
never: push the site outside the deploy windows
